senses.en: Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it.
In a lower position, often beneath a covering.

ex.en: Your slippers are underneath the chair by the bed.
Insulation installed underneath floors can reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in older homes.

col: underneath the surface｜bên dưới bề mặt
tip: Khi theo sau là danh từ thì là giới từ; dùng đứng một mình thì là phó từ.

senses.zh: được phép; cho phép (quá khứ/quá khứ phân từ của permit)
senses.en: allowed something; the past tense and past participle of permit

ex.en: We were permitted to feed the goats at noon.
Students should be permitted to use digital tools when these genuinely support learning rather than distract from it.

col: be permitted to do something｜được phép làm gì
legally permitted｜được pháp luật cho phép
tip: permit gấp đôi chữ t ở quá khứ; dạng bị động theo sau là to do.

senses.en: Covered with small round marks or patches.

ex.en: A spotted dog was sleeping beside the garden gate.
Some spotted animals blend into their surroundings, making them harder for predators to detect.

tip: Cũng là quá khứ hoặc quá khứ phân từ của spot, nghĩa là phát hiện.

senses.zh: tượng đài; công trình tưởng niệm
senses.en: A structure built to honour a person or important event.
An old structure valued for its historical importance.

ex.en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.

col: a monument to｜công trình tưởng niệm
a historic monument｜di tích lịch sử
tip: Tưởng niệm ai hoặc việc gì dùng a monument to.

senses.en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below.
A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat.
To question someone intensely, often for a long time.

ex.en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.

col: under the grill｜bên dưới nguồn nhiệt của vỉ nướng
grill someone about something｜tra hỏi ai về việc gì
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh, grill thường nướng bằng nhiệt từ trên xuống; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường nướng từ bên dưới.

senses.en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value
the remains of a building that has been badly damaged

senses.zh: sự sụp đổ; sự phá sản
senses.en: the complete loss of money, success, or good condition

ex.en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.

col: ruin someone's plans｜phá hỏng kế hoạch của ai
financial ruin｜sự phá sản về tài chính
tip: Chỉ tàn tích công trình thường dùng số nhiều ruins, như ancient ruins.

senses.zh: buổi hội thảo thực hành; workshop
senses.en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together.
A room or building where things are made or repaired.

ex.en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.

tip: Khi chỉ hoạt động học tập, workshop nhấn mạnh sự tham gia và thực hành, không chỉ nghe giảng.

senses.en: A friend or someone you share an activity with
An animal's partner for breeding
To breed, or bring animals together to breed

ex.en: I'm meeting a mate for lunch near the station.
Some bird species stay with the same mate for years, sharing responsibility for raising their young.

col: mate for life｜gắn bó với một bạn đời suốt đời
tip: Nghĩa “bạn bè” là tiếng Anh Anh thân mật; trong văn viết trang trọng nên dùng friend.

senses.en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural.
A shop selling food and basic household supplies.

ex.en: I carried two bags of groceries into the kitchen.
Rising grocery prices place considerable pressure on households that already spend most of their income on essentials.

col: grocery bill｜hóa đơn mua thực phẩm
tip: Hàng tạp hóa dùng số nhiều groceries; làm định ngữ dùng grocery.

senses.zh: làm cho buồn cười; làm vui
senses.en: To make someone smile or laugh.

senses.zh: giải trí; làm cho khỏi chán
senses.en: To keep someone pleasantly occupied.

ex.en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.

col: amuse an audience｜làm khán giả vui
keep someone amused｜giúp ai không thấy chán
tip: amused tả cảm giác của người; amusing tả điều thú vị.

senses.en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities.
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.

col: become a citizen｜trở thành công dân
a responsible citizen｜công dân có trách nhiệm
tip: citizen nhấn mạnh tư cách công dân; resident nhấn mạnh nơi cư trú.

senses.en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish

senses.zh: công thức; bí quyết dẫn đến kết quả
senses.en: a method or situation likely to produce a particular result

ex.en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.

col: follow a recipe｜làm theo công thức nấu ăn
a recipe for success｜bí quyết thành công
a recipe for disaster｜công thức dẫn đến thảm họa
tip: recipe là cách nấu món ăn; menu là thực đơn, prescription là đơn thuốc.

senses.en: the need for food or suffering caused by its lack
a strong desire for something
to want something very strongly

ex.en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.

col: satisfy your hunger｜làm dịu cơn đói
a hunger for knowledge｜khát khao tri thức
hunger for success｜khao khát thành công
tip: Danh từ thường không đếm được; khao khát điều gì dùng hunger for.

senses.en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness
intense excitement shared by a person or group

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.

tip: Nói bị sốt thường dùng have a fever, cũng có thể nói have a temperature.

senses.zh: tủ có khóa; tủ đựng đồ
senses.en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure

ex.en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.

col: school locker｜tủ đựng đồ ở trường
tip: locker là tủ nhỏ để cất đồ cá nhân, có khóa.

senses.en: Existing or happening in all parts of the world.
In or to all parts of the world.

ex.en: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.

col: worldwide recognition｜được công nhận toàn cầu
available worldwide｜có sẵn trên toàn thế giới
tip: Vừa là tính từ, vừa là phó từ: sell worldwide.

senses.en: during the recent period up to the present

ex.en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.

col: have lately become｜gần đây đã trở nên
more often lately｜gần đây thường xuyên hơn
tip: Thường dùng với thì hiện tại hoàn thành; đừng nhầm với late (muộn).

senses.en: A small object that holds things together or in place.
A short section of a film or audio recording.
To fasten with a clip, or cut something shorter.

ex.en: She used a clip to hold her hair back.
Teachers can use a short video clip to introduce complex scientific concepts before a classroom discussion.

col: clip something onto｜kẹp vật gì vào
tip: Kẹp vào đâu dùng clip onto; đoạn video ngắn cũng gọi là clip.

senses.en: more important than anything else

senses.zh: tiểu học; thuộc giáo dục tiểu học
senses.en: relating to the first stage of formal schooling
original or direct, rather than derived from something else

ex.en: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.

col: primary concern｜mối quan tâm hàng đầu
tip: primary school là trường tiểu học; primarily là phó từ.

senses.en: Easy to notice or understand.

ex.en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
The environmental benefits of cycling are obvious, but safer routes are needed to encourage more people to cycle.

col: an obvious advantage｜lợi thế rõ ràng
for obvious reasons｜vì những lý do hiển nhiên
obvious to everyone｜ai cũng thấy rõ
tip: Thường dùng It is obvious that… nghĩa là “rõ ràng là…”.

senses.en: A long-handled tool for washing floors
To clean a surface or remove liquid with absorbent material

ex.en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
Staff should mop shared floors regularly to maintain hygiene in schools and other public buildings.

col: mop up a spill｜lau sạch chỗ đổ
a mop and bucket｜cây lau nhà và xô
tip: Quá khứ mopped, V-ing mopping, đều gấp đôi chữ p.

senses.en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away

ex.en: The baby-sitter read our daughter a story before bed.
Hiring a reliable baby-sitter can help parents balance occasional evening work with their family responsibilities.

col: hire a baby-sitter｜thuê người trông trẻ
reliable baby-sitter｜người trông trẻ đáng tin cậy
experienced baby-sitter｜người trông trẻ có kinh nghiệm
tip: Ngày nay thường viết là babysitter; chỉ người trông trẻ tạm thời.

senses.en: To officially accept or allow something.
To think that someone or something is good or acceptable.

ex.en: My manager approved my request for a day off.
Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.

col: approve a proposal｜phê duyệt đề xuất
approve of something｜tán thành điều gì
approve an application｜phê duyệt đơn xin
tip: Phê duyệt việc gì dùng approve; tán thành điều gì dùng approve of.

senses.en: a talk that explains something to an audience
the way something is arranged, shown, or expressed
the formal act of giving something to someone

ex.en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.

tip: Thuyết trình dùng give a presentation; lưu ý trọng âm của present khi là động từ.

senses.en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible
to control how much something can increase or happen

ex.en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.

col: set a limit｜đặt ra giới hạn
limit something to｜giới hạn điều gì trong phạm vi
tip: limit A to B nghĩa là giới hạn A trong phạm vi B.

senses.en: Having a pattern of long, narrow bands.

ex.en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
The striped coats of certain animals may help them avoid detection in their natural habitats.

col: striped shirt｜áo sơ mi kẻ sọc
tip: striped nghĩa là có sọc; quá khứ của strip là stripped.

senses.en: A hard rectangular block used for building walls and houses.

ex.en: One loose brick fell out of the garden wall.
Reusing brick from demolished buildings can reduce construction waste and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.

tip: Một viên gạch là đếm được; gọi chung vật liệu xây dựng có thể không đếm được.

senses.en: Someone whose job is to design buildings

senses.zh: người kiến tạo; người thiết kế
senses.en: Someone who plans and develops an important change or project

ex.en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.

col: qualified architect｜kiến trúc sư có chứng chỉ
chief architect｜kiến trúc sư trưởng; người thiết kế chính
the architect of reform｜người thiết kế cuộc cải cách
tip: architect chỉ người; architecture là ngành kiến trúc hoặc phong cách kiến trúc.

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.

col: buy a souvenir｜mua quà lưu niệm
as a souvenir｜làm quà lưu niệm
tip: Thường dùng a souvenir of để chỉ món quà lưu niệm của một chuyến đi hoặc sự kiện.

senses.en: either side of the face below the eyes

senses.zh: sự trơ tráo; sự láo xược
senses.en: rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect

ex.en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.

col: a kiss on the cheek｜nụ hôn lên má
have the cheek to｜trơ tráo làm gì
tip: Nghĩa “má” đếm được; nghĩa “láo xược” thường không đếm được, hay dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh thân mật.

senses.en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal.
Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.

ex.en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.

col: achieve an ambition｜thực hiện hoài bão
ambition to succeed｜tham vọng thành công
tip: Chí hướng cụ thể đếm được, chí tiến thủ không đếm được; thường theo sau là to do.

senses.en: using highly developed technology or methods
requiring knowledge or skills beyond a basic level

senses.zh: giai đoạn muộn; tiến triển nhiều
senses.en: having reached a late stage of development or progress

ex.en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.

col: advanced learners｜người học trình độ nâng cao
at an advanced stage｜ở giai đoạn muộn
tip: advanced nghĩa là tiên tiến hoặc nâng cao; thông báo trước dùng advance notice.

senses.zh: tai nghe nhét tai; tai nghe
senses.en: A small device worn in or over an ear for listening

ex.en: One earphone fell out while I was jogging.
Students using earphones in shared study spaces can listen to educational recordings without disturbing others.

col: a pair of earphones｜một cặp tai nghe
tip: Thường dùng số nhiều earphones; một bộ tai nghe nói a pair of.

senses.zh: thị trưởng; chủ tịch thị trấn
senses.en: The official who leads or represents a city or town

ex.en: The mayor opened our new swimming pool yesterday.
The newly elected mayor has promised to improve public transport and create more affordable housing for residents.

col: the mayor of a city｜thị trưởng của một thành phố
run for mayor｜tranh cử thị trưởng
tip: mayor là thị trưởng; đừng nhầm với major (chính, chủ yếu).

senses.en: A substance that can seriously harm or kill living things.
Harm living things or contaminate something with a toxic substance.

senses.zh: làm hỏng; đầu độc (mối quan hệ)
senses.en: Make a relationship or situation unpleasant or harmful.

ex.en: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
Toxic waste from poorly regulated factories can poison rivers, threatening wildlife and the health of nearby communities.

col: poison the water supply｜làm ô nhiễm nguồn nước
poison relations｜làm hỏng các mối quan hệ
tip: poison là danh từ hoặc động từ; tính từ “độc” là poisonous.

senses.en: Symbols or instructions representing information, including instructions for computers

senses.zh: quy tắc ứng xử; quy chuẩn
senses.en: A set of rules governing behaviour or practice
Write computer instructions or convert information into a coded form

ex.en: I forgot the code for my bicycle lock again.
Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.

col: code of conduct｜quy tắc ứng xử
tip: Mã chương trình thường không đếm được; một mật mã cụ thể có thể nói a code.

senses.en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting
a single image or page shown during a presentation
a sloping structure that children slide down

ex.en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.

col: go down a slide｜chơi cầu trượt
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là slid.

senses.en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed

senses.zh: giá trị lớn nhất; mức trần
senses.en: the greatest amount or level possible or allowed

ex.en: This lift has a maximum capacity of eight people.
Governments should set maximum limits on industrial emissions to protect public health and improve air quality.

tip: a maximum of nghĩa là “tối đa là”; từ trái nghĩa là minimum.

senses.zh: sự tiết kiệm; khoản tiết kiệm
senses.en: a reduction in the money, time, or resources used
money kept rather than spent, usually for future needs

ex.en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.

col: make a saving｜tiết kiệm chi phí
energy savings｜lượng điện năng tiết kiệm
life savings｜tiền tiết kiệm cả đời
tip: Tiền tiết kiệm thường dùng số nhiều savings; sự tiết kiệm có thể dùng số ít.

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: người ủng hộ; người bảo vệ
senses.en: someone who strongly supports a cause or group
to actively support or defend a cause or person

ex.en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.

col: world champion｜nhà vô địch thế giới
defending champion｜nhà đương kim vô địch
a champion of equality｜người ủng hộ bình đẳng
champion a cause｜ủng hộ một sự nghiệp
tip: Khi là động từ, theo sau là tân ngữ trực tiếp: champion a cause.

senses.en: A small electric light carried in the hand.
A stick with burning material at one end, providing light.

ex.en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.

col: switch on a torch｜bật đèn pin
a torch beam｜chùm sáng đèn pin
a flaming torch｜ngọn đuốc đang cháy
tip: Đèn pin trong tiếng Anh Anh là torch, tiếng Anh Mỹ là flashlight.

senses.en: A narrow break in a surface or solid object
Break or cause something to break without completely separating
A sudden sharp sound, like something breaking

ex.en: There's a thin crack across my favourite blue mug.
Engineers discovered a crack in the bridge during a routine inspection and recommended immediate repairs.

col: a crack in the wall｜vết nứt trên tường
tip: crack thường chỉ nứt chứ chưa vỡ; shatter nhấn mạnh vỡ thành nhiều mảnh.

senses.zh: sự thanh toán; việc trả tiền
senses.en: the act of giving money for something
an amount of money paid or due to be paid

ex.en: The shop accepts payment by card or cash.
Digital payment systems can make everyday transactions more convenient, but they may exclude people without internet access.

tip: Hành động trả tiền thường không đếm được; một khoản tiền cụ thể dùng a payment.

senses.en: Feeling or showing happiness and a positive attitude.
Making a place or experience feel bright and pleasant.

ex.en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.

tip: Có thể tả người vui vẻ, cũng có thể tả không gian tươi sáng.

senses.en: a word showing relationships, such as location, direction, or time

ex.en: Our teacher used a toy rabbit to explain each preposition.
Choosing the correct preposition helps language learners express relationships between ideas more precisely in academic writing.

col: a preposition of place｜giới từ chỉ nơi chốn
a preposition of time｜giới từ chỉ thời gian
tip: Theo sau giới từ thường là danh từ, đại từ hoặc V-ing.

senses.en: Feeling extremely afraid.

ex.en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.

col: terrified at the thought of｜kinh hãi khi nghĩ đến
tip: Người cảm thấy sợ dùng terrified; vật gây sợ dùng terrifying.

senses.en: people or things arranged in a straight line
to move a boat through water using oars

senses.zh: cuộc cãi vã; sự ồn ào
senses.en: a noisy argument or loud disturbance

ex.en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.

col: in a row｜thành một hàng; liên tiếp
tip: Nghĩa “hàng, chèo thuyền” đọc /rəʊ/; nghĩa “cãi vã” đọc /raʊ/.

senses.en: Sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement beneath Earth's surface.

ex.en: The earthquake made the cups rattle on our kitchen shelf.
Strict building regulations can significantly reduce the risk of injury when an earthquake strikes a densely populated city.

col: a powerful earthquake｜trận động đất mạnh
an earthquake strikes｜động đất xảy ra
earthquake damage｜thiệt hại do động đất
tip: Danh từ đếm được; nói xảy ra động đất có thể dùng an earthquake strikes.

senses.en: Money paid to the government to fund public services.
Require someone to pay money to the government.

senses.zh: gây gánh nặng; làm kiệt sức
senses.en: Put heavy demands on someone's strength or abilities.

ex.en: The tax on my monthly salary has gone up.
Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.

tip: tax là danh từ hoặc động từ; taxing thường nghĩa là tốn sức, mệt mỏi.

senses.zh: sự che chở; sự trú ẩn
senses.en: Protection from danger or bad weather.

senses.zh: nơi trú ẩn; chỗ che chắn
senses.en: A place that provides safety or protection.
To stay somewhere protected, or protect someone from harm.

ex.en: We found shelter under a bridge during the storm.
Local authorities should provide temporary shelter for residents whose homes have been damaged by floods.

col: animal shelter｜trạm cứu hộ động vật
tip: Nghĩa “sự che chở” thường không đếm được; chỉ một nơi trú ẩn cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: to a moderate degree, but not very

senses.zh: một cách công bằng; công tâm
senses.en: in a way that treats people equally and reasonably

ex.en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.

col: treat people fairly｜đối xử công bằng với mọi người
distribute resources fairly｜phân phối tài nguyên công bằng
tip: Chỉ mức độ thì yếu hơn very; fairly good là khá tốt, không phải rất tốt.

senses.zh: giác quan; khả năng cảm nhận
senses.en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.
A feeling or awareness of something.
To become aware of something without being directly told.

ex.en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.

col: sense of belonging｜cảm giác thuộc về
tip: make sense là có lý, dễ hiểu; make sense of là hiểu ra điều gì.

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

ex.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.

col: a roll of tape｜một cuộn băng dính
tip: Băng dính thường không đếm được; một cuộn nói a roll of tape.

senses.en: A passage built underground or through a hill.
To dig a passage underground or through something.

ex.en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.

tip: Giới từ through thường chỉ việc đi xuyên qua bên trong đường hầm.

senses.en: A path intended for walking rather than driving.

ex.en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
Maintaining rural footpaths encourages outdoor recreation while helping visitors avoid damage to surrounding farmland.

col: public footpath｜lối đi bộ công cộng
follow a footpath｜đi theo lối mòn
tip: Thường chỉ lối mòn dành cho người đi bộ, không nhất thiết sát đường lớn.

senses.en: an amount of money
the total obtained by adding amounts together
to state the main points, usually with up

ex.en: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
Governments invest large sums in public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.

col: a large sum of money｜một khoản tiền lớn
tip: sum up nghĩa là tóm tắt; một khoản tiền dùng a sum of money.

senses.en: decorative paper used to cover interior walls
an image displayed behind icons on a screen
to cover walls with decorative paper

ex.en: We chose pale green wallpaper for our small bedroom.
Choosing durable wallpaper can reduce the frequency of interior renovations and limit household material waste.

col: patterned wallpaper｜giấy dán tường có họa tiết
a roll of wallpaper｜một cuộn giấy dán tường
tip: wallpaper thường không đếm được; một cuộn nói a roll of wallpaper.

senses.en: To reach, or make something reach, more people or places
To open something out or cover a surface with something

senses.zh: sự lan truyền; sự phân bố
senses.en: The process of reaching a wider area or more people

ex.en: She spread a blanket under the tree for our picnic.
The rapid spread of false information online highlights the importance of teaching critical reading skills in schools.

col: the spread of disease｜sự lây lan của bệnh
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là spread.

senses.zh: cởi quần áo; cởi đồ cho ai
senses.en: To take off your own clothes or someone else's clothes.

ex.en: I undressed behind the curtain and put on pyjamas.
Healthcare staff should provide private spaces where patients can undress comfortably before a physical examination.

col: undress for bed｜thay đồ để đi ngủ
tip: undress có thể không có tân ngữ; cởi một món đồ cụ thể dùng take off.

senses.en: a view or situation that you see
the place where an event happens
a short part of a play or film

ex.en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.

tip: scene đếm được; scenery là phong cảnh nói chung, không đếm được.

senses.zh: niềm đam mê; sự yêu thích mãnh liệt
senses.en: a very strong enthusiasm for an activity or subject

senses.zh: đam mê; cảm xúc mãnh liệt
senses.en: a powerful feeling, especially love or anger

ex.en: Her passion for baking fills our kitchen with delicious smells.
Teachers who share their passion for science can inspire students to pursue careers in research.

col: a passion for music｜đam mê âm nhạc
develop a passion for｜nảy sinh đam mê với
pursue your passion｜theo đuổi đam mê của bạn
tip: Diễn đạt đam mê với điều gì dùng a passion for.

senses.en: Studying material again to prepare for an examination

senses.zh: sự sửa đổi; bản chỉnh sửa
senses.en: The process or result of changing something to improve it

ex.en: I do my revision at the kitchen table.
Regular revision helps students retain knowledge more effectively than studying intensively just before an examination.

tip: Nghĩa “ôn tập” chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng review.

senses.en: moving stairs that carry people between floors

ex.en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.

col: an upward escalator｜thang cuốn đi lên
tip: escalator là thang cuốn; lift là thang máy.

senses.en: In most cases or at most times.
By most people or across most places.

ex.en: I generally walk to work unless it rains.
Public transport is generally more energy-efficient than private cars, especially when services carry large numbers of passengers.

col: generally accepted｜được chấp nhận rộng rãi
generally regarded as｜thường được coi là
tip: generally chỉ phần lớn trường hợp, không phải không có ngoại lệ; đầu câu có thể dùng generally speaking.

senses.en: Objects placed together, often one on top of another.
To put things together in a heap.

ex.en: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
When waste collection services are inadequate, piles of rubbish can threaten public health in densely populated neighbourhoods.

col: a pile of books｜một chồng sách
pile plates on a table｜chồng đĩa lên bàn
tip: a pile of theo sau là vật được chất đống; pile up nghĩa là tích tụ.

senses.en: A small portable electric light powered by batteries.

ex.en: She used a flashlight to look under the bed.
Households should keep a flashlight readily available to improve safety during unexpected power cuts.

col: turn on a flashlight｜bật đèn pin
tip: Cách nói của tiếng Anh Mỹ cho đèn pin; tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng torch.

senses.en: A small cloth used for wiping your nose or face.

ex.en: She pulled a clean handkerchief from her coat pocket.
Using a washable handkerchief instead of disposable tissues can reduce everyday household waste.

col: a clean handkerchief｜chiếc khăn tay sạch
a cotton handkerchief｜khăn tay bằng cotton
a pocket handkerchief｜khăn tay bỏ túi
tip: Chỉ khăn nhỏ lau mặt, lau mũi; thường không chỉ khăn trùm đầu.

senses.en: Working by itself without direct human control.
Done without conscious thought or deliberate effort.
Happening as a direct result without a separate decision.

ex.en: The automatic doors opened as I approached the supermarket.
Automatic lighting systems can reduce energy consumption by switching off when nobody is present in a room.

tip: Có thể chỉ máy móc tự vận hành, cũng có thể chỉ phản ứng không suy nghĩ của con người.

senses.en: very interested in something or eager to do it
quick to notice or understand things
very strong or intense

ex.en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.

col: keen on sport｜say mê thể thao
a keen eye for detail｜con mắt tinh tường về chi tiết
tip: keen on theo sau là danh từ hoặc V-ing; keen to theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu.

senses.en: A hard outer covering protecting an animal, egg, or nut.
To remove the hard outer covering of something.
An explosive object fired from a large gun.

ex.en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
Rising ocean acidity can weaken the shells of marine animals, threatening their survival and wider ecosystems.

col: shell peas｜bóc vỏ đậu Hà Lan
tip: shell khi là động từ có thể nghĩa là bóc vỏ; shell peas là bóc đậu Hà Lan.

senses.en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing
to apply ink to a surface

ex.en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.

tip: ink là danh từ thường không đếm được; viết bằng mực dùng in ink.

senses.zh: sự diễn đạt; sự biểu lộ
senses.en: The act of showing thoughts or feelings through words or actions.
The look on someone's face that reveals feelings.
A word or phrase with a particular meaning.

ex.en: He sent flowers as an expression of his gratitude.
Schools should encourage creative expression by giving students regular opportunities to explore music, drama, and visual arts.

col: freedom of expression｜tự do ngôn luận
an expression of gratitude｜lời bày tỏ lòng biết ơn
tip: Nghĩa “nét mặt, cách nói” đếm được; nghĩa “sự diễn đạt” thường không đếm được.

senses.en: Thin cord used for tying or fastening things.
A stretched wire or thread that produces musical sounds.
A series of connected things or events.

ex.en: I tied the parcel with a piece of string.
A string of successful conservation projects has demonstrated the value of involving local communities in environmental protection.

col: a piece of string｜một đoạn dây
a string of successes｜một chuỗi thành công
tip: Dây nói chung thường không đếm được; dây đàn và string trong a string of thì đếm được.

senses.en: Money earned after paying the costs of a business.
To gain money or an advantage from something.

ex.en: The bakery made a small profit this month.
Companies should invest part of their profit in cleaner technology to reduce environmental damage.

tip: profit là lợi nhuận sau khi trừ chi phí, không đồng nghĩa với doanh thu (revenue).

senses.en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.

ex.en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.

col: too embarrassed to ask｜quá ngượng nên không dám hỏi
tip: Người cảm thấy ngượng dùng embarrassed; việc gây ngượng dùng embarrassing.

senses.zh: làm hào hứng; làm phấn khích
senses.en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager
to cause a particular feeling or reaction

ex.en: Trips to the seaside always excite my younger sister.
Interactive science exhibitions can excite young visitors and encourage them to explore scientific ideas independently.

col: excite curiosity｜khơi dậy sự tò mò
excite the imagination｜kích thích trí tưởng tượng
tip: Người cảm thấy hào hứng dùng excited; vật gây hào hứng dùng exciting.

senses.en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings.
Causing great suffering or disappointment.

ex.en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.

col: be cruel to animals｜ngược đãi động vật
a cruel remark｜lời nói cay độc
a cruel blow｜đòn giáng nặng nề
tip: Tàn nhẫn với ai hoặc con vật nào dùng be cruel to.

senses.en: A book containing maps of the world or particular regions.

ex.en: We opened the atlas to find a mountain range.
Although digital maps are convenient, a printed atlas helps students compare geographical patterns across entire continents.

col: world atlas｜tập bản đồ thế giới
historical atlas｜tập bản đồ lịch sử
road atlas｜tập bản đồ đường bộ
tip: atlas là tập bản đồ đóng thành sách; số nhiều là atlases.

senses.en: A long walk, usually through the countryside or mountains.
To walk a long distance, especially in natural surroundings.
A large increase in a price, cost, or rate.

ex.en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.

col: go for a hike｜đi bộ đường dài
tip: hike thường chỉ chuyến đi bộ dài ngoài trời, cũng có thể chỉ giá tăng đột ngột.

senses.en: A baby bird, especially a young chicken.

ex.en: A yellow chick followed the hen across the yard.
Conservation teams monitor each newly hatched chick to assess whether habitat restoration is improving breeding success.

col: newly hatched chick｜chim non mới nở
day-old chick｜gà con một ngày tuổi
tip: Không chỉ gà con mà còn có thể chỉ chim non của các loài khác.

senses.en: Goods available for sale or supplies kept for future use.
Shares representing ownership in a company.
To keep goods available for sale or use.

ex.en: The shop has fresh stock arriving early tomorrow morning.
Small retailers often struggle to maintain sufficient stock when transport disruptions delay deliveries from major suppliers.

col: the stock market｜thị trường chứng khoán
stock up on food｜tích trữ thực phẩm
tip: Hàng tồn kho thường không đếm được; nói về cổ phiếu của nhiều công ty có thể dùng stocks.

senses.en: someone you do not know
someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community

ex.en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.

col: complete stranger｜người hoàn toàn xa lạ
stranger to the area｜người mới đến khu vực này
no stranger to｜không còn lạ gì với
tip: stranger là người lạ, không đồng nghĩa với foreigner (người nước ngoài).

senses.en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives
the act of being chosen for a position by voting

ex.en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.

col: hold an election｜tổ chức bầu cử
tip: elect nhấn mạnh bỏ phiếu để chọn; select là chọn nói chung.

senses.en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light.

senses.zh: theo sát; đi theo học việc
senses.en: To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.

ex.en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.

tip: shadow là cái bóng cụ thể; shade thường là chỗ râm mát tránh nắng.

senses.en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness.
A substance taken for its effects on mind or body.
To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.

ex.en: The doctor prescribed a drug to ease her pain.
New drug development requires extensive testing to ensure that treatments are both safe and effective.

tip: Có thể chỉ thuốc chữa bệnh hoặc ma túy; cần dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: Containing alcohol.

senses.zh: nghiện rượu; do rượu gây ra
senses.en: Affected by alcohol dependence, or caused by alcohol.
A person who is dependent on alcohol.

ex.en: The waiter asked whether we wanted any alcoholic drinks.
Clear information about alcoholic beverages can help consumers understand health risks and make more informed choices.

col: alcoholic liver disease｜bệnh gan do rượu
tip: Khi nói về người, nên dùng person with alcohol dependence để tôn trọng hơn.

senses.en: seeds of crops such as wheat, used as food
a very small hard piece of a substance
the natural pattern of lines in wood

ex.en: The farmer stored the grain in a dry barn.
Growing grain requires reliable water supplies, which are increasingly threatened by drought in many agricultural regions.

col: a grain of sand｜một hạt cát
tip: Ngũ cốc nói chung thường không đếm được; một hạt riêng lẻ thì đếm được.

senses.en: not treating people equally or reasonably

ex.en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.

col: unfair advantage｜lợi thế không công bằng
unfair competition｜cạnh tranh không lành mạnh
unfair to someone｜bất công với ai
tip: Bất công với ai dùng unfair to someone.

senses.en: Not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes or damage.

ex.en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.

col: a careless mistake｜lỗi do bất cẩn
careless with money｜tiêu tiền bừa bãi
tip: careless là bất cẩn; carefree mới là vô lo vô nghĩ.

senses.zh: thám tử; cảnh sát điều tra
senses.en: Someone whose job is to investigate crimes or discover facts

ex.en: The detective found a muddy footprint beside the window.
Modern detectives increasingly rely on digital evidence, which raises important questions about privacy and data protection.

tip: Trong detective novel, detective là danh từ làm định ngữ.

senses.en: coming after the ninety-ninth in a sequence
one of a hundred equal parts of something

ex.en: Our village celebrated its hundredth anniversary with a picnic.
The athlete missed the qualifying time by just one hundredth of a second, demonstrating the precision required.

col: the hundredth anniversary｜lễ kỷ niệm một trăm năm
one hundredth of a second｜một phần trăm giây
for the hundredth time｜lần thứ một trăm; vô số lần
tip: Số thứ tự nghĩa là thứ một trăm; a hundredth nghĩa là một phần trăm.

senses.en: to clean a surface using a brush or broom
to move quickly and powerfully across an area

ex.en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là swept.

senses.en: Facts or information showing that something is true.
A printed or digital copy checked before final publication.
Able to resist damage or effects from something.

ex.en: Keep your receipt as proof that you paid.
Governments should require clear proof of a treatment's effectiveness before allowing it to be widely marketed.

col: proof of identity｜giấy tờ chứng minh danh tính
burden of proof｜nghĩa vụ chứng minh
tip: Nghĩa “bằng chứng” thường không đếm được; chứng minh toán học có thể dùng a proof.

senses.en: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space
Rise or increase very quickly

ex.en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.

tip: Khi là động từ thường tả giá cả tăng vọt, mạnh hơn increase.

senses.en: to stop briefly before continuing
a short break in an activity or speech

ex.en: She paused at the door to check her bag.
Teachers should pause after asking questions to give students enough time to develop their answers.

col: pause for a moment｜dừng lại một lát
tip: pause là dừng tạm thời, thường hàm ý sẽ tiếp tục sau đó.

senses.zh: văn học; tác phẩm văn học
senses.en: Written works valued for their artistic qualities.
Written material about a particular subject.

ex.en: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.

tip: Thường không đếm được; khi chỉ nhiều tài liệu cũng không thêm s.

senses.en: The process of expressing meaning in another language.
A spoken or written version in another language.

ex.en: This translation of the story is easy to understand.
Accurate translation allows researchers from different countries to share findings and collaborate more effectively.

col: translation into English｜bản dịch sang tiếng Anh
tip: Dịch sang ngôn ngữ nào dùng into; dịch từ ngôn ngữ nào dùng from.

senses.en: Not expected to happen or be true.
Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.

ex.en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.

col: unlikely to happen｜không chắc xảy ra
highly unlikely｜cực kỳ khó xảy ra
an unlikely friendship｜một tình bạn bất ngờ
tip: Thường dùng be unlikely to do hoặc It is unlikely that.

senses.en: The front window of a car or other vehicle.

ex.en: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.

col: windscreen wipers｜cần gạt nước kính chắn gió
cracked windscreen｜kính chắn gió bị nứt
heated windscreen｜kính chắn gió có sưởi
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh dùng windscreen; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng windshield.

senses.zh: phiếu quà tặng; phiếu giảm giá
senses.en: A document exchangeable for goods, services, or a discount.
A document supporting a payment or accounting entry.

ex.en: I used my gift voucher to buy new shoes.
Governments can provide training vouchers to help unemployed adults develop skills required by local employers.

tip: Thường dùng a voucher for; đổi phiếu dùng redeem a voucher.
